# MealManageAPI
# This is Repo for the MealManage API
# This is a Spring Data Rest / Spring Boot Application
# This will expose GET POST PUT and DELETE methods to work on mealManageDB

###Subdomain for meal school auto-generated based on following below rules.
1. Generate subdomain based on School name (i.e. first three letter from school name). 
2. If generated subdomain already exist then appending previous subdomain with alphabet letter generated by last one digit of state zip (e.g. 0 as a, 1 as b, 2 as c...................9 as j).
3. If that is also exist then consider 2nd last digit as alphabet from state zip and append it with generated subdomain on 2nd mentioned point.
4. If generated subdomain by point 3 also exist then it'll not allow onboard school.
